name: Fondom Studios (Guneku Branch)
role: Media partner of MEFU and MECUDA
description: A media and cultural production company founded by a son of Guneku, working to raise the image and reputation of the village and the wider Meta clan through media and affordable service at home. It is described as one of the first legally registered media companies in Momo Division, and produces live event coverage in the village.
plans: A new branch with partners in Mbengwi Village, with the approval of the Ministry of Vocational Training
sourceNote: Self-description circulated in the village group, August 2026.
